articles.title: SEC proposes new crypto custody rules for investment advisers and funds
articles.snippet: The regulator issued a proposed rule for custody, marking a swan song for its inaugural Crypto Task Force chief, Commissioner Hester Peirce, who exits this week.

articles.title: Another Trump memecoin dinner advertised for token's top investors

articles.title: NEAR Intents hit by $3.8 million exploit as crypto's rough year of hacks continues
articles.snippet: The popular cross-chain trading system said it will reimburse losses after a bug affected deposits and withdrawals across several networks.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin posts tentative gains as rates drop ahead of Friday's jobs report

articles.title: Bitcoin kicks off new quarter in the old $82,000-$85,000 price range
articles.snippet: Prices briefly topped $85,000 on Wednesday after weaker-than-expected U.S. inflation cooled bets on Fed rate hikes, But bulls couldn’t hold the move and spot ETFs didn’t help.
